Jack Channon's gelding looks the main threat to the selection. Trojan Soldier and Shielas Well could both get involved but will need a bit more than they've currently shown.

He stayed on powerfully that day suggesting the extra two furlongs will be right up his street, and that effort can probably be marked up as he was the first one home drawn in double figures. There's likely a bit more to come yet. That Doncaster race is likely to be key here as just one place and a neck behind the selection at Doncaster was Whatacracker (also drawn out wide) and off the same terms the son of Cracksman is entitled to push the selection again, while Freddy Robinson finished about a length in front of both but enjoyed a smoother trip closer to the inner and is penalised a pound by the handicapper. Both the former can reverse placings with Brian Ellison's gelding. Dr Rio and Prince Achile are the two most likely to trouble this trio.

selections.comment: A tight affair. Moby Quick hls every chance on form and would be the selection but there's a nagging doubt about whether he'll be as effective back on turf as he was on the AW. Beltadaay will prove popular for good reason as James Horton's charge impressed when landing his handicap debut in convincing style (over 4 lengths) in deep ground when last seen in October. A similar effort may well be enough but it's unlikely he's fully wound up and the ground is unlikely to be anything like as testing. So, one that might offer a bit more juice in it's price is HARSWELL RUBY. Roger Fell's filly has been ultra-consistent in her six races. If anything the return to turf looks a positive and a mark of 66 looks well within her compass. Expect a bold run. Law Degree and Blueandtangerine are others high on the list.

Almost any of them could win, but THE DRAGON KING is taken to prevail. He is very risky, but much better than he has shown to date and finished like a train when he finally buckled down to win the Tattersalls October Auction Stakes. He is not one to rely on, but if he puts it in he is probably well handicapped. Dark Cloud Rising is a more reliable alternative having won tidily on his reappearance. Cayman Tai is handicapped to reverse that form and could go well at a price.
